metric_ja: 生成 AI を使った人（15〜64 歳、四半期）
source_name: Microsoft, The state of global AI diffusion in 2026 (Q1 2026)
note: Verbatim: 'AI usage increased by 1.5 percentage points from 16.3% to 17.8% of the world's working age population' (Q1 2026); defined as 'the share of people worldwide between ages 15 and 64 who have used a generative AI product during the reported period', from adjusted Microsoft telemetry. 0.178 × 5,421,227,666 = 964,978,525. A quarter-long window and a telemetry model — used as the independent top-down estimate, not as a product count. Its China component is probably low (weak telemetry there); the China union comes from QuestMobile instead. A 2026-09-21 update (June 2026, 18.8%) exists and is not used, to keep the quarter's time points consistent.
